fingerprint.test_tokens: lowercase alphanumeric tokens from failing test commands, stop-token filtered
fingerprint.class_tokens: exception names ending Error/Exception plus AssertionError and pytest assertion marker
fingerprint.message_tokens: lowercase alphanumeric tokens from failing output, stop-token filtered

family_construction.order: immutable global order: lock project order then candidate_order position
family_construction.join_rule: candidate must satisfy edge threshold and guard against every existing family member
family_construction.overflow: leave later matching members unused and unopened
family_construction.family_selection: first qualifying family in frozen order
